objects.description: The [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1044) FilepakMonitor component can inject into the Bka.exe process using the `VirtualAllocEx`, `WriteProcessMemory` and `CreateRemoteThread` APIs to load the DLL component.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
objects.description_fa: مؤلفه [FunnyDream](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1044) FilepakMonitor می‌تواند با استفاده از «VirtualAllocEx»، «WriteProcessMemory» و «CreateRemoteThread» به فرآیند Bka.exe تزریق کند تا مؤلفه DLL را بارگیری کند.[[VE_0]]ER (Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020)
